summary: Quantum BioPharma filed a 6-K attaching a press release disclosing that Rodman Renshaw initiated analyst coverage with a BUY rating and US$8 price target, dated September 17, 2026; the coverage is unpaid and no consideration was provided. No transaction, stake, price-per-share deal, premium, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or structural mechanic is present; the release also recaps the 19.48% retained Unbuzzd stake and 7%-to-3% royalty terms. This is a routine third-party research-initiation disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies beyond monitoring any later corporate action.
